_comment: Every setting of the experiment, written before any reranking run. Documents, chunks, questions, and splits are 05-hybrid-search's, unchanged. The first stage finds candidates; the reranker reorders only those candidates; the budget is filled from the reranked order, and chunks outside the candidate set are never used. Scores are kept per (question, chunk) pair: a pair's score doesn't depend on which first stage proposed it, and each pair is scored once per run.

first_stages.vector: cosine similarity, every chunk ranked (as in 05)
first_stages.rrf: reciprocal rank fusion of vector and BM25 (words analyzer, k1 1.2, b 0.75), k = 60 (as in 05)

reranker.score: log-odds at the first output position: logsumexp of the log-probabilities of the 'yes' tokens minus logsumexp of the 'no' tokens, among the top_logprobs alternatives. A label with no token among them gets the lowest listed log-probability (an upper bound for it). It is a model-derived relevance score, not a calibrated probability.
reranker.order: candidates by score, highest first; ties by first-stage rank

repeat_check.note: after the full run, a seeded random sample of scored pairs is scored again (Python) and compared
